decisions.why: verified 26/08/2026 against Interweave's own site (interweavetextiles.com/products/amb-sup/): the division is patient warming/thermal management for pre-hospital and emergency use — THERMARMOUR passive thermal blankets, ponchos and hypothermia evacuation bags, the same product class as the existing theatres:warm type (patient warming & temperature), just used in ambulance/pre-hospital settings rather than the OR. Clinell Universal Wipes, the fourth named example, is a minor accessory item within an otherwise warming-focused division
